title: Crunchbase: San Francisco startups hit a record of 1,404 seed deals in 2025; the number of NYC seed deals has dropped over the past three years, to 666 in 2025 (Yuliya Chernova/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Yuliya Chernova / Wall Street Journal: Crunchbase: San Francisco startups hit a record of 1,404 seed deals in 2025; the number of NYC seed deals has dropped over the past three years, to 666 in 2025 — 'You can't ignore San Francisco right now,' says one New York venture capitalist — New York venture firms are broadening their geographic reach.
